clue.text: The trouble about a Spaniard is he puts pleasure before work

indicators.note: about means the anagram goes round the Spaniard
trouble suggests disorder, so the letters of the and is are stirred up

parts.note: Don is a Spanish gentleman's title, so a Spaniard

explanation.surface: A complaint about a Spaniard who would rather enjoy himself than work.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the second half: a pleasure-seeker is exactly someone who puts enjoyment before work, while 'a Spaniard' is the title Don.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasure-seeker is defined by putting enjoyment ahead of duty or labour.

clue.text: Often drunk; too much is bad for it

definitions.text: Often drunk; too much is bad for it

parts.words: Often drunk; too much is bad for it
parts.note: suggests drinking to excess, but means a toast that is drunk and the wellbeing excess harms

explanation.definitionFit: Drinkers raise glasses 'to your wellbeing', yet heavy drinking damages one's fitness.

clue.text: It need not give rise to punishment

definitions.text: It need not give rise to punishment

indicators.note: give rise to means these letters produce something new when rearranged

explanation.surface: Being kept back need not lead to a penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: Being held in custody or kept after school, which need not be a penalty.

clue.text: They may be held in revulsion

definitions.text: They may be held in revulsion

parts.words: They may be held in revulsion
parts.note: suggests things loathed, but means the facial features people pinch at a bad smell

explanation.definitionFit: People pinch their nostrils shut when disgusted by a stench.

clue.text: Here one comes close to the main form of English

definitions.text: Here one comes close to the main

indicators.note: form of means a reshaping of the word's letters

explanation.surface: Talking about a dialect that nearly sounds like standard English.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is an old word for the sea, so the definition is a pebbly beach at the water's edge.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a beach of pebbles is where a person reaches the sea's edge.

clue.text: Mischievous Zulus quiet

parts.note: an impi is a Zulu regiment, impis the plural
sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: A remark that Zulu warriors are being playfully naughty in silence.
explanation.walkthrough: IMPIS are Zulu warrior regiments; SH is the hush for silence.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: like a little imp, playfully naughty.

clue.text: Thinks the current recession divides friends

indicators.note: divides means the turned word splits the friends

parts.note: mates are friends

indicators.note: recession means the word for current goes back

parts.note: a tide is a current

explanation.surface: Someone reflecting that an economic downturn breaks up friendships.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recession' turns TIDE into EDIT, which 'divides' MATES as M-EDIT-ATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: ponders, reflects deeply.

clue.text: Publish and I p-prosecute

parts.note: the stammer in the clue word is copied: prosecute means sue, stuttered as s-sue

explanation.surface: A nervous editor stammering about publishing and being taken to court.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphenated stammer tells you to stammer the synonym too: sue becomes S-SUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to put out a book or magazine.

clue.text: Fairly good around the home

indicators.note: around means the good word goes round the home

parts.note: holy means good, virtuous
a nest is a home

explanation.surface: Being quite well-behaved about the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fairly' looks like 'quite', but here it means justly, in a fair manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: justly, in a fair and truthful manner.

clue.text: It turns its back in a curve, in an aesthetic way

definitions.note: an adverbial phrase standing for an adjective, read as 'of an aesthetic kind'

indicators.note: in places the turned pieces inside the curve

parts.note: an arc is a curve

indicators.note: turns means the word it is read backwards
back means the word its is read backwards too

explanation.surface: Something twisting round on itself in a graceful curving line.
explanation.walkthrough: Two separate reversal signals, 'turns' and 'back', each work on the word beside them.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: showing taste and a feeling for beauty in creation.

clue.text: The single boy in a family is very much a favourite

parts.note: odd means single, one of an unmatched pair
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: The only son in a family is the parents' darling.
explanation.walkthrough: Betting term: an ODDS-ON horse is so fancied the bookmaker pays less than the stake.
explanation.definitionFit: In betting, a runner priced at less than evens is the strong favourite to win.

clue.text: Farm labourer cut flower

indicators.note: cut means the flower loses its last letter

parts.note: a peony is a flower

explanation.surface: A farmhand who trimmed blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: A peon is a Latin American day labourer or unskilled farmworker.

clue.text: Grasping secret societies?

definitions.meaning: a device used for gripping, a pair of pincer arms

explanation.definitionFit: A gripping kitchen implement, and also the plural of a Chinese secret fraternity.

clue.text: A big-head celebrity

parts.note: great means big
a ness is a headland, a head jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A conceited, swollen-headed famous person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'big-head' looks like one insult for a conceited person; split it, and a ness is a headland or promontory.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym in the sense of fame or eminence: renown that sets someone apart.

clue.text: Sit out with a girl in gauzy fabric

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are put out of order

parts.note: Sue is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone sitting outdoors with a girlfriend dressed in filmy cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Tissue can mean a fine, delicate, see-through woven material.

clue.text: Doctor seen in unusual haste at the sauna

indicators.note: seen in places the doctor inside the mixed letters
unusual means the letters appear in an odd order

parts.note: MB is a Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor

explanation.surface: A medic glimpsed in an unusual rush at the sauna.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' rearranges HASTE AT to STEAATH; 'seen in' puts MB inside it: STEA-MB-ATH.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a hot room filled with vapour for sweating.

clue.text: Unsophisticated old city in part of S Africa

indicators.note: in puts the city inside the province

parts.note: Natal is a former province of South Africa
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city

explanation.surface: Describing a simple, rustic old town somewhere in South Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: unaffected and artless, free of polish or pretension.

clue.text: Check the impulse to increase support

parts.note: to rein is to check or hold back
force is an impulse, a driving power

explanation.surface: A matter of restraining an urge in order to bolster backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to strengthen or bolster with extra backing.

clue.text: Fat, and very wet

definitions.meaning: the grease that runs from roasting meat

explanation.definitionFit: Meat fat collected from a roast, and an adjective for soaked.

clue.text: Poem, an ode concocted in game

indicators.note: in places the mixed letters inside the game

parts.note: RU is rugby union, the game

indicators.note: concocted means made up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A verse being written up during a match.
explanation.walkthrough: RU, for rugby union, is the usual crossword abbreviation for the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a rondeau is a short French verse form with a refrain.

clue.text: Ruin a French party

parts.note: un is French for a
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A French party ends in disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to bring to nothing, cancel out.

clue.text: Country where you may see us in exotic sari

indicators.note: in places us inside the mixed letters
exotic suggests something strange, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A traveller picturing themselves wrapped in a foreign garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the largest nation on earth, spanning Europe and Asia.

clue.text: Article about a concert

indicators.note: about here means turned around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece written on a musical performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a solo musical performance.

clue.text: They cut some of the grass

definitions.meaning: sharp edges of knives or razors

explanation.definitionFit: Sharp cutting edges, and also slender leaves of grass.

clue.text: One might aid camper that's collapsed

definitions.text: One might aid camper that's collapsed

indicators.note: collapsed means fallen apart, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone who would help a camper who has fainted.
explanation.definitionFit: A medically trained first responder would help anyone who has fallen ill.

clue.text: Wild anger of Lear's daughter

indicators.note: wild suggests disorder, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: The fury of King Lear's child.
explanation.walkthrough: Lear here is Shakespeare's King Lear, whose daughters are Goneril, Regan and Cordelia.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one of the ungrateful elder daughters in Shakespeare's tragedy.

clue.text: Legitimate student expelled with dire result

indicators.note: expelled means the student is thrown out of the word

parts.note: lawful means legitimate
L is a learner, the student

explanation.surface: A lawful student was thrown out, with terrible consequences.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: dreadful, terrible in effect.

clue.text: A right that's legal but unacceptable

parts.note: a lien is a legal right over another's property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: Something legally permitted but morally objectionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Alien can mean repugnant, contrary to one's nature or principles.

clue.text: Dressed up and ready to go?

definitions.meaning: of a vehicle, with a gear engaged so it can move off

explanation.definitionFit: Clothing sense of gear, and also an engine meshed for driving away.

clue.text: Bar on a flight

parts.note: suggests a drinks counter on an aeroplane, but means a rod on a staircase

explanation.definitionFit: A metal rod holding carpet against each step of a staircase.

clue.text: He was partly known for his fasting and his leadership

definitions.text: He was partly known for his fasting and his leadership

indicators.note: partly means only part of these words gives the name

explanation.surface: A description of an Indian leader famed for hunger strikes.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mahatma led India's independence movement and used fasting as protest.

clue.text: Provides soft soap and face cloths for the cricket team?

definitions.meaning: the white trousers worn by cricketers

explanation.definitionFit: Verb for flattery, plural for washcloths, and cricket whites, all from the soft woollen fabric.
